acceptanceCriteria: The authoritative Phase 9 evaluator returns PILOT_READY with every required approval and evidence reference valid
openActions: Close all Phase 9 certification gates without inferring or manufacturing an owner approval

acceptanceCriteria: A current signed authorization names the cohort, capabilities, owners, window, thresholds and rollback authority
openActions: Authorized owners must issue a time-bounded production authorization after Phase 9 is PILOT_READY

acceptanceCriteria: Every pilot tenant reference is approved, non-ambiguous and bound to the authorized capability set
openActions: Product and BMS Architecture must select and approve the smallest pilot tenant cohort

acceptanceCriteria: Every branch is approved, operationally staffed and belongs to an authorized tenant in the cohort
openActions: Product and Operations must select and approve explicit pilot branches

acceptanceCriteria: The authorization lists only Phase 9-certified capabilities and keeps all financial or provider-blocked capabilities disabled
openActions: Owners must approve the minimum launch capability set and its explicit exclusions

acceptanceCriteria: The current time is inside an approved bounded window with named engineering, SRE and operations coverage
openActions: Owners must approve a launch window only after staffing and rollback coverage are confirmed

acceptanceCriteria: Every approved SLO has an observable threshold that pauses expansion and initiates rollback evaluation
openActions: SRE and Product must approve numeric thresholds, dashboards, paging and observation windows

acceptanceCriteria: A named authority can stop expansion and execute rehearsed rollback triggers without waiting for a new approval
openActions: Name the rollback authority, approve objective triggers and rehearse the production-shaped rollback path

acceptanceCriteria: Each increasing stage has an approved cohort percentage, observation time, entry checks, exit checks and explicit stop decision
openActions: Owners must convert the non-executable stage template into authorized stages for the selected cohort
